title: A Signal class
prompt:
Write a ModuleScript that returns a Signal class. `Signal.new()` makes a signal with methods:
`:Connect(fn)` returns a connection object with `:Disconnect()`; `:Fire(...)` calls every connected function with
the arguments; `:Once(fn)` connects a function that runs only on the next Fire; `:Wait()` yields until the next Fire
and returns its arguments. Tables passed to Fire must arrive as the same table (not a copy).
